reasons.correctness: FaqRepository#findByActiveFalseAndLastUpdateTimeBefore, FaqService#purgeInactiveOlderThan(int) and InactiveFaqPurgeCronJob match the interface: enabled/days/cron properties with the stated defaults, skip when disabled, catch-and-log on failure. Hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: @Scheduled cron from property, @SchedulerLock named support:faqPurge, @Value enabled flag, *CronJob name, @RequiredArgsConstructor with a private final FaqService, config added to application.yml. No schema or endpoint change, so no other convention applies.
reasons.design_fit: Derived query sits in the repository, deletion logic in FaqService, and the cron job only delegates. It reuses ShedLock and the pattern of AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob. Small footprint, no duplicated lookup.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest checks the returned count, the deleteAll call, the empty result and the cutoff window through a captor. InactiveFaqPurgeCronJobUnitTest covers enabled, disabled (verifyNoInteractions) and a swallowed exception. Mockito only, no Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the faq package files and the existing *CronJob classes. The agent then read AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob as the exemplar before editing. Test and config discovery afterwards relied on grep and find.
